name: WORD
matches: A run of Unicode word characters, as regex `\w`: letters, digits, marks and connector punctuation such as `_`.

name: NOTSPACE
matches: A run of anything but whitespace.

name: SPACE
matches: Any whitespace, or none.

name: INT
matches: An integer, with an optional sign.

name: POSINT
matches: A positive integer, with no leading zero.

name: BASE10NUM
matches: A decimal number, with an optional sign and fraction.

name: BASE16NUM
matches: A hexadecimal number written with `0x`.

name: NUMBER
matches: The same as `BASE10NUM`.

name: IPV4
matches: A dotted IPv4 address, each part 0 to 255, with no leading zeros.

name: IPV6
matches: An IPv6 address in any RFC 4291 form, with an optional zone such as `%eth0`.

name: IP
matches: An IPv4 address, else an IPv6 one.

name: HOSTNAME
matches: A dotted host name; each label is letters, digits, `_` and inner `-`. It may end with `.`.

name: IPORHOST
matches: An IP address, else a host name.

name: USERNAME
matches: Letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, or a Windows account written with `\`, `@` or `$`.

name: UUID
matches: A UUID in its 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal form, in braces or not, or as 32 hexadecimal digits.

name: MAC
matches: A MAC address: pairs split by colons or dashes, groups of four split by dots, two halves split by a dash, or no separator.

name: DATA
matches: Any text, as little as lets the rest of the pattern match.

name: GREEDYDATA
matches: Any text, as much as lets the rest of the pattern match.

name: QUOTEDSTRING
matches: Text in double, single or back quotes, with backslash escapes; the quotes are part of the match.

name: LOGLEVEL
matches: A log level name in any case: trace, debug, dbg, info, information, inf, notice, warn, warning, wrn, err, error, crit, critical, fatal, severe, emerg, emergency, alert, panic, verbose, fine, finer, finest.

name: MONTH
matches: A month name, full or three letters, in any case.

name: MONTHNUM
matches: A month number, 1 to 12, with an optional leading zero.

name: MONTHDAY
matches: A day of the month, 1 to 31, with an optional leading zero.

name: YEAR
matches: A year of two or four digits.

name: HOUR
matches: An hour, 0 to 23.

name: MINUTE
matches: A minute, 00 to 59.

name: SECOND
matches: A second, 00 to 59 with an optional fraction after `.` or `,`, or a bare 60.

name: TIME
matches: `HOUR:MINUTE`, with an optional `:SECOND`.

name: TIMESTAMP_ISO8601
matches: `YEAR-MONTHNUM-MONTHDAY`, `T` or a space, then the time and an optional `Z` or offset. The time's colons are optional, and its parts take the widths of their own patterns, so `26-1-4T930` matches too.

name: HTTPDATE
matches: A web server log's date, `day/month/year:time zone`.

name: SYSLOGTIMESTAMP
matches: A syslog date, `month day time`.

name: SYSLOGHOST
matches: A syslog line's host, an IP address or host name.

name: URIPROTO
matches: A URI scheme.

name: URIHOST
matches: An IPv4 address, an IPv6 address in brackets, or a host name, with an optional `:port`.

name: URIPATH
matches: A run of ASCII letters, digits and `$.+!*'(){},~:;=@#%&[]|_/-`. It stops at `?`.

name: URIPATHPARAM
matches: A URI path with an optional `?query`.

name: SYSLOGLINE
matches: A classic syslog line: an optional `<priority>`, a date, a host, an optional `program[pid]:`, then the message.

name: SYSLOG5424LINE
matches: An RFC 5424 syslog line: `<priority>version`, a timestamp, host, app, process id and message id, structured data, then an optional message; a field written as `-` is left out.
example: <165>1 2003-10-11T22:14:15.003Z mymachine.example.com evntslog - ID47 [exampleSDID@32473 iut="3"] An application event

name: COMMONAPACHELOG
matches: A web server's common log line: client, identity, user, `[date]`, the quoted request, status and bytes; a field written as `-` is left out.

name: COMBINEDAPACHELOG
matches: A combined log line: a common log line, then the quoted referrer and user agent; a field written as `-` is left out.
